cards.headline: Track eight on a monumental debut
cards.snippet: LP1, released by Young Turks on 6 August 2014, was FKA twigs' debut album, and it landed fully formed: Metacritic scored it 86, Pitchfork named it the second-best album of 2014, and it was shortlisted for the Mercury Prize. Twigs produced it with Arca, Emile Haynie, Clams Casino, Paul Epworth, Sampha, Dev Hynes and Tic. 'Closer' is the eighth of its ten tracks, written by twigs and Tic and produced by twigs, with Tic and Cy An adding guitar and drums — an album about desire and intimacy whose most devoted song is built like a hymn.
cards.context: The album frame: where 'Closer' sits on LP1, and who made it.

cards.headline: 'Essentially a hymn' — her words
cards.snippet: Asked about her sacred-music streak in 2019, twigs pointed back at this song herself: 'Even on LP1, I had “Closer”, which is essentially a hymn. I spent a lot of time in choir as a child and I went to Sunday school, so it's part of who I am.' She was listening to a lot of Gregorian music at the time, drawn to medieval chords. The lyric follows the upbringing: a beloved addressed as a saviour, footsteps in the sand, and a singer asking to be led to a place free from all the wrongs she does.
cards.context: Twigs on the song's roots, from Apple Music's Magdalene album notes (2019).

cards.headline: The highlight that ends on 'isolation'
cards.snippet: The Line of Best Fit called 'Closer' the record's highlight: 'a solemn hymn for a decrepit future', a tearjerk eulogy in a futuristic coating, carried by her choral coo and ambient R&B. What makes it strange is the landing. After three minutes of devotion — 'I'm here to be closer to you' — the song doesn't resolve; it ebbs away repeating a single word from its first verse: 'Isolation, isolation, isolation.'
cards.context: How the critics heard it in August 2014: devotion that dissolves into its opposite.

cards.headline: Björk-level within a decade
cards.snippet: this is such an exceptionally beautiful song. the hymnal elements with the beats and those profound lyrics. FKA twigs is such a visionary! everything she does is inventive. I believe that within the next decade she'll have solidified herself in BJORK level status!!!!!
cards.context: The fullest defense in the pool: the hymnal elements, the profound lyrics, and a ten-year prophecy.

cards.headline: She almost never sings it on stage
cards.snippet: Fan-filmed at the Roundhouse in London on 20 February 2015, the second of two consecutive nights — the previous night's film is even titled 'Dancing to Closer'. She rarely performs the song live, and the listeners under both films say so. One listener: "Yeeeeeees! OMG, I wondered why she never performed "Closer" on stage. This sounds more phenomenal than the studio version. She really brought a show to her stomping grounds."
cards.context: A fan film from the LP1-era Roundhouse run — the song's rare live outing, danced as much as sung.
